primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: FEV1 is the amount of air which can be forcibly exhaled from the lungs in the first second of a forced exhalation. Baseline was defined as the last non-missing measurement prior to the first study drug administration. The primary time point was defined as the average of weeks 13 and 14. FAS=Full analysis set.

groups.description: Single-dose of placebo was administered by oral inhalation via nebulizer, once every week for up to 13 weeks.
groups.title: Placebo

groups.description: Single-dose of ION-827359 37.5 mg was administered by oral inhalation via nebulizer, once every week for up to 13 weeks.
groups.title: ION-827359 37.5 mg

groups.description: Single-dose of ION-827359 75 mg was administered by oral inhalation via nebulizer, once every week for up to 13 weeks.
groups.title: ION-827359 75 mg

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: FAS=all randomized participants who had ≥1 dose of study drug(ION 827359/placebo),≥1 post-Baseline efficacy assessment(i.e.,post-Baseline FEV1,Exacerbations of Chronic pulmonary Disease Tool\[EXACT\]Respiratory Symptoms\[E-RS\]score,Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease\[COPD\]Assessment Test\[CAT\]score,or St.George's Respiratory Questionnaire-COPD Specific\[SGRQ-C score\],post-bronchodilator FEV1).Overall number analyzed:number of participants with data available for analyses in this outcome measure.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.timeFrame: From Baseline up to average of Weeks 13 and 14
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change From Baseline to the Primary Time Point in Forced Expiratory Volume in 1 Second (FEV1) Compared to Placebo
